list.empty_desc: Find vacancies that match you and apply — you can track their status here.
list.archive_empty_desc: Closed applications (hired, rejected or withdrawn) will appear here.
list.vacancy_unavailable: This vacancy is no longer available

detail.withdraw_desc: Once withdrawn, the employer won't see your application and you won't be able to resubmit it.
detail.hired_desc: Rate your experience with the employer — it helps other candidates.

review.title: Rating
review.desc: How did it go? Your review will appear on the profile after moderation.
review.sent_desc: It will be published after moderation.

pipeline.title: Candidates
pipeline.empty_desc: Candidates will appear here once they apply.
pipeline.filter_empty_desc: Choose another status or clear the filter.

candidate.interview_desc: Send the candidate the interview time and place — they'll get a notification.
candidate.offer_desc: Offer the candidate a job. You can describe the terms in a note.
candidate.offer_note_placeholder: Salary, start date and other terms (optional)
candidate.hire_desc: The application will be closed and the candidate notified. You can rate them afterward.
candidate.reject_desc: The candidate will be notified of the rejection. You can add a reason.
candidate.terminal_hint: This application is closed — its status can't be changed.
candidate.view_only_hint: You have view-only access — contact your company administrator to change statuses.

status_hint.sent: The employer hasn't viewed it yet
status_hint.interview: You've been invited to an interview

errors.review_requires_hire: You can only leave a rating after being hired
errors.invalid_transition: The status can't be moved back
errors.invalid_interview_time: The interview must be scheduled in the future (within 120 days)

interview.title: Invite to interview
interview.desc: Pick a date and time — the candidate will be notified via Telegram.
interview.place_placeholder: E.g. Chilanzar block 5, office 12, or a Zoom link
interview.worker_hint: If the time doesn't work for you, message the employer in chat.

bulk.reject_desc: Candidates will be notified. Adding a reason will help them.
bulk.none: This action can't be applied to the selected applications

notes.title: Private notes
notes.hint: Visible only to you and your team. The candidate can't see them.
notes.placeholder: E.g. strong experience, need to discuss salary
